# MOON GLASSES

> MOON GLASSES is an Indian D2C sunglasses brand built for night-out, fashion-first wear. Five frame shapes across sixteen-plus colourways, flat pricing at ₹1,499 (acetate) or ₹1,999 (metal), ships across India.

MOON GLASSES sells sunglasses grouped into a Core Collection (the everyday lineup — Wayfarer, Round, Rectangle, Aviator, Octagon shapes, in acetate or metal frames) and a Limited Series of drop-only colourways. Every pair ships with a branded MOON Glasses case and a microfiber cleaning cloth, and includes UV400 lens protection.

All acetate frames are priced at ₹1,499 and metal frames at ₹1,999 (inclusive of GST). Orders ship across India, typically arriving within a few business days. Returns and exchanges are accepted within the return window stated on the Refund & Cancellation Policy for unused items with tags attached.
